decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch builds directly on the firm's woodworking and assembly know-how, so management can read its market response and refine the models without new knowledge.
The one-tier pyramid is a core Erzgebirge-style product, fully within the firm's craft knowledge, and was shown prominently on the home page.

Although the electronics lie outside the firm's knowledge base and it does little R&D, the firm presents this line as a flagship and has likely sourced the mechanism from a partner, so it will keep it while it learns.

This peripheral accessory for the electronic music box is distant from the firm's competence, only mentioned on the website, and its results are hard to interpret, making it a likely candidate for pruning.
The seasonal Christmas motif connects to the firm's carving and painting skills, giving it a bit more grounding than the generic platform, so it stays as a complement to the music box line.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craftsmanship and draws on its existing regional design knowledge.
